operating_contract.evidence_requirement: An explicitly bound, scoped assessor record must identify the assessor, tenant and service boundary, source revision, assessment period, population reconciliation, applicability decision, evidence references, methods, outcomes and exceptions. Reconciled inventories of all scoped accounts, roles and groups; joiner, mover and leaver automation; privilege change records; execution results and exceptions; stale or orphaned identity detection; coverage of non-user identities and external identity providers. Record measure objectives, the documented cycle and interruptions for persistent measures, verification of automation accuracy and sufficiency (or why automation is unnecessary), and validation that measures are operating as intended. Missing evidence or unknown applicability blocks a conclusion. This is an assessor assertion, not an automated demonstration of the indicator or independent approval. A snapshot cannot establish persistent performance. Expected failure modes: Unmanaged groups or service identities, incomplete joiner/mover/leaver coverage, failed disablement jobs, unreviewed privilege changes, or missing population reconciliation.

Scoped user population and authentication methods; passwordless enforcement and validation; documented feasibility exceptions; strong-password and phishing-resistant MFA enforcement for each exception; enrollment, recovery and bypass paths; execution results and exceptions. Record measure objectives, the documented cycle and interruptions for persistent measures, verification of automation accuracy and sufficiency (or why automation is unnecessary), and validation that measures are operating as intended. Expected failure modes: Password-only fallback, phishable MFA, undocumented feasibility exceptions, unenrolled users, bypass or recovery paths, and policy configuration without enforcement evidence.
